Label: Active Transit Score
Description: A 100-point composite index combining real-time bus frequencies, light rail proximity, and historical transit delay metrics.

Label: Active Commute Score
Description: Measures typical peak-hour drive and transit durations from city center to major Puget Sound employment hubs.

Label: Puget Sound Academic Index (PSAI)
Description: Our proprietary 100-point rating evaluating OSPI standardized test performance, student-teacher ratios, and graduation rates.

Label: Climate Comfort Index
Description: A custom 100-point livability rating based on annual sunshine hours, temperature moderation, and seasonal precipitation levels.

Label: Real Estate Market Hotness
Description: A real-time market gauge evaluating months of inventory, median days on market, and list-to-sale price ratios.

Label: Months of Inventory / Supply
Description: The estimated time in months it would take to sell all active residential inventory at the current pace of sales.

Label: Tide Height & Water Level
Description: Real-time NOAA tide station observations indicating current water height, rising/falling movement, and upcoming high/low tide predictions.

Label: Sunrise & Sunset Times
Description: Daily solar cycle calculation showing exact dawn and dusk timestamps alongside proportional daylight progression.

Label: Current Weather & Forecast
Description: Hyper-local meteorological observations including temperature, humidity, precipitation probability, and 7-day outlook.

Label: Emergency Alert Center
Description: Real-time multi-agency hazard tracking powered by 15-minute syncs with state EOC, weather services, and dispatch feeds.

Label: Power Outage Status
Description: Live utility grid monitoring retrieving active outage counts, affected customers, and restoration estimates from Puget Sound Energy and Snohomish PUD.

Label: Surveillance Score & Profile
Description: An evaluation of municipal traffic cameras, license plate readers, and public surveillance technology footprint.

Label: Crime Statistics & Safety Metrics
Description: Localized property and violent crime rates compiled from municipal police department reports and FBI UCR data.

Label: WSRB Fire Rating
Description: Washington Surveying and Rating Bureau classification score determining fire protection capabilities and insurance underwriting tiers.

Label: Fire & EMS Live Dispatch
Description: Real-time incident feed parsing active 911 calls, emergency responses, and unit deployments within city limits.

Label: Wildfire Perimeter Tracker
Description: NIFC REST endpoint data mapping active fire boundaries, smoke plume trajectory, and regional burn bans.

Label: USGS Seismic Activity Tracker
Description: Live USGS seismic feed capturing earthquakes exceeding M3.0 within a regional radius of the Puget Sound basin.

Label: Hospital Emergency & CMS Rating
Description: Proximity metrics for the nearest 24/7 emergency room along with official CMS star quality ratings.

Label: Building & Electrical Permits
Description: Weekly aggregation of municipal construction permits, commercial developments, and L&I electrical inspection filings.

Label: Property Tax Trends & Levies
Description: Historical effective property tax rates, voter-approved municipal levies, and county assessor valuation shifts.

Label: EV Infrastructure Score
Description: A 100-point rating measuring public charging station density, high-speed DC fast charger availability, and municipal EV readiness.

Label: H3 Broadband & Fiber Coverage
Description: H3 spatial index indicating fiber optic availability, gigabit internet providers, and regional digital infrastructure access.

Label: Walkability Score
Description: A 100-point rating measuring pedestrian friendliness, sidewalk coverage, and walking distance to daily amenities.

Label: Bikeability Score
Description: A 100-point index evaluating dedicated bike lanes, trail connectivity, and road topography.

Label: Transit On-Time Performance
Description: OneBusAway feed tracking real-time delay minutes for King County Metro, Sound Transit, and Community Transit routes.

Label: WSDOT Toll Rates
Description: Live dynamic pricing for SR 520 bridge, I-405 express toll lanes, and SR 99 tunnel corridors.

Label: WSDOT Ferry Status & Wait Times
Description: Real-time vessel tracking, terminal line wait estimates, and sailing schedule status for Puget Sound ferry routes.

Label: Airport Flight Status & Delays
Description: Live flight arrival and departure board tracking for Sea-Tac (SEA) and Paine Field (PAE) commercial terminals.

Label: City Council Meetings & Agendas
Description: Links and feeds to municipal meeting schedules, ordinance filings, video archives, and public comment opportunities.

Label: Elections & Drop Box Locations
Description: Official ballot drop box coordinates, voting district boundaries, candidate profiles, and live SOS vote tallies.

Label: Down Payment Assistance Programs
Description: Eligible state and local homebuyer assistance programs, income thresholds, and grant availability.

Label: Condo FHA / VA Approval Status
Description: Government financing eligibility status for individual condominium associations across King and Snohomish counties.
